addedRows.nonReplaceability: Offer acceptance or rejection actor mode, subject, delegation/source receipt and reason are immutable decision facts; mutating ppl_rec_offers status cannot preserve decision history.
Correction versus future supersession, effective interval, predecessor and reason require append-only requisition versions rather than rewriting the mutable requisition root.

Ordered task identity, actor rule, due anchor, applicability condition and completion/evidence schema need relational keys and exact historical query lineage that a digest or untyped JSON blob cannot enforce.
Simulation request identity, pinned input/assumption revision and immutable result receipt lifecycle are distinct from the scenario revision and must be independently replayable.
Eligibility policy/snapshot/decision proof must remain immutable and auditable independently of a mutable enrollment status.
A bounded ordered set of tokenized dependent relationship elections requires per-row uniqueness, option/version linkage and field-policy-safe query lineage; a digest cannot reproduce it.
Life-event decision actor/source/delegation and outcome are immutable facts and cannot be reconstructed from the current life-event or enrollment state.
Signed access grant/revoke outcomes are immutable owner receipts on a separate access lifecycle; engagement state cannot serve as their proof.

A stable engagement identity cannot also be overwritten to represent correction and future supersession; effective interval, predecessor, revision mode, classification/access intent and reason require append-only versions with non-overlap.
Executable content, delivery/session, capacity, eligibility and skill-map revisions must be addressable as-of without rewriting the offering root.
Atomic reserve, release and waitlist ordering are ledger facts needed for concurrency-safe capacity replay and cannot be reduced to an offering counter.
Criteria, capacity and skill requirements must be pinned to the opportunity revision seen by applicants and explanations; mutable root columns cannot preserve that historical input.

Stable succession-plan identity must be separated from restricted audience, key-position, content and effective-time revisions; a publication receipt cannot reproduce historical plan content or authorization policy.
Every compensation amount/component/reason/effective-date CAS revision must remain frozen for approval and snapshot derivation rather than being overwritten in the proposal root.
Plan approval freezes an exact ordered proposal-ID/version set; a plan digest cannot prove membership or support server-derived approved snapshot lines.
Approval outcome, decision receipt and candidate version are immutable facts separate from candidate status and are required for publish admission and historical refetch.

Human actor, assistance/subject identity, confirm-or-reject decision, reason and decision/delegation receipt have a distinct audience and retention lifecycle from model-output provenance and must remain immutable.

acceptanceRules: The live manifest tableScopeChange must pin the frozen 115-table set hash and declare exactly these 17 additions, zero removals and activeTableSpecifications=132.
Every added row must reproduce the exact ownerSession, complete producer set, exact declared readConsumers and non-empty nonReplaceability reason.
Every added table must have an exact table specification, producer DML and same-owner keys/constraints appropriate to the stated immutable fact.

Every declared detail/list reader for all 17 additions must include the table in readPlan.tables and projectionTuple.physicalSources, expose at least two exact durable table.column per-field response lineage bindings, enforce field-policy classification/redaction and preserve exact historical refetch where an event names the fact.

ppl_wfp_simulation_requests alone permits exact monotonic REQUESTED to COMPLETED, FAILED or CANCELLED UPDATE_CAS while all immutable input pins remain unchanged; all other added decision/version/ledger rows remain append-only.

Every added table must preserve FORCE RLS, named retention policy and field-policy-safe query projection; AI review, contingent engagement version and succession plan version require their specialized immutable controls.
